faqs.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions

branches.question: Does the system support multiple branches?
branches.answer: Yes, the system supports multiple branch management with centralized monitoring and unified reports.

excel.question: Can I import data from Excel?
excel.answer: Yes, you can easily import products, customers, and suppliers from Excel files.

zatca.question: Is the system compliant with ZATCA requirements?
zatca.answer: The platform can be prepared to support e-invoicing requirements depending on the required technical setup and implementation.

payments.question: What payment methods are supported?
payments.answer: Available payment methods depend on the integrations and technical setup implemented for your project scope.

offline.question: Does the system work offline?
offline.answer: Offline mode availability depends on your approved technical setup and deployed system configuration.
